duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

translation.en: Our Lord, accept from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُسْلِمَةً لَكَ

translation.en: Our Lord, make us Muslims to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation to You.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَارْنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ

translation.en: Our Lord, show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

translation.en: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ

translation.en: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا

translation.en: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا

translation.en: Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ

translation.en: Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ

translation.en: Our Lord, pardon us and forgive us and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً

translation.en: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

translation.en: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess in our affairs and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

translation.en: Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You above such a thing; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا

translation.en: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, saying, 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ

translation.en: Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ

translation.en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ

translation.en: Our Lord, do not place us among the wrongdoing people.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ

translation.en: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ

translation.en: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِي رَحْمَتِكَ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ

translation.en: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ

translation.en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ

translation.en: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ

translation.en: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا نَجِّنَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ

translation.en: Our Lord, save us from the wrongdoing people.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَذَا الْبَلَدَ آمِنًا وَاجْنُبْنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَنْ نَعْبُدَ الْأَصْنَامَ

translation.en: My Lord, make this city secure and keep me and my sons from worshipping idols.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًا مِنَ النَّاسِ

translation.en: My Lord, indeed they have led astray a great number of the people.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ

translation.en: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and many from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطَانًا نَصِيرًا

translation.en: My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا

translation.en: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا

translation.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ

translation.en: My Lord, do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَنْزِلْنِي مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ

translation.en: My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate us.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ

translation.en: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

translation.en: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

translation.en: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا

translation.en: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

translation.en: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and do not put in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed.
